chunk_text: If Saturn, the Moon and Mercury are together in the 9th from Upapada, there will be no sons at all.
The Sun, Jupiter and Rahu placed together in the 9th from Upapada will give a number of sons.
The Moon placed in the 9th from Upapada will give a son.
A mixture of planets in the 9th from Upapada will delay the obtainment of a son.
The son caused by the conjunction of the Sun, Jupiter and Rahu in the 9th from Upapada will be strong, valorous, greatly successful and will destroy enemies.
If Mars and Saturn are in the 9th from Upapada, there will be no son, or a son will be obtained by adoption or a brother's son will come in adoption.
In all these cases concerning the 9th from Upapada, odd signs will yield many sons while even signs will cause only a few.
If Leo happens to be Upapada and is aspected by the Moon, there will be a limited number of children.
If Virgo happens to be Upapada, it will cause many daughters.
Rahu and Saturn in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada will destroy the co-born of the native. Placement in the 11th affects elder brothers/sisters and in the 3rd affects younger ones.
If Venus is in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, there would have been an abortion to the mother earlier.
The same effect of an earlier abortion to the mother occurs if Venus is in the 8th from the natal ascendant, or from Lagnarudha (Arudha Lagna).
Should the Sun, Jupiter, Mercury and Mars be in the 3rd or 11th from the Lagna Pada, there will be many valorous co-born.
Should Saturn and Mars be in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, or lend aspects thereto, younger and elder co-born will respectively be destroyed.
If Saturn is alone in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada, the native will be spared while the co-born will die.
Ketu in the 3rd or 11th from Lagna Pada will give abundant happiness from one's sisters.
If the 6th from Lagna Pada is occupied by a malefic and is bereft of conjunction or aspect of a benefic, the native will be a thief.
If Rahu is in the 7th or 12th from Lagna Pada, or aspects one of the said houses, the native will be endowed with spiritual knowledge and be very fortunate.
If Mercury is in Lagna Pada, the native will lord over a whole country.
If Jupiter is in Lagna Pada, the native will be a knower of all things.
Venus in Lagna Pada denotes a poet or speaker.
If benefics occupy the 2nd from the Upapada or from Lagna Pada, the native will be endowed with all kinds of wealth and be intelligent.
One will surely become a thief if the lord of the 2nd from Upapada is in the 2nd house from the natal ascendant, and is with a malefic planet.
If Rahu is in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th (counted from Upapada), the native will have long and projected teeth.
Ketu placed in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th (counted from Upapada) will cause stammering.
Saturn placed in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th (counted from Upapada) will make one look ugly.
Mixed will be the effects if there are mixed planets in the 2nd from the lord of the 7th (counted from Upapada).
